steps.instruction: Read the request, role-appropriate delivered source receipt and published business authority. Verify sourceRole is be or fe, target is implemented or in-progress, the receipt came from the corresponding generator, and its commit equals the bound checkout head. Ask for missing provenance.

calls.purpose: Read delivered provenance and published authority.
Verify the delivered checkout head without mutation.

steps.instruction: Inspect the role-selected source at the frozen head. Normalize delivered facts with role, path, line range and head. Treat quality, UAT and API receipts as supporting evidence only and turn contradictions into discrepancies.

reads.when: when sourceRole is be and the path supports a matrix row
when sourceRole is fe and the path supports a matrix row
when a verification receipt is supplied

calls.purpose: Read the exact delivered source and supporting evidence.

steps.instruction: Compare every frozen matrix row against delivered claims. Record a complete reconciliation with evidence and discrepancy per dimension, plus all supplied unchecked coverage. Do not edit or replace the matrix. If any discrepancy stands, write the mismatch artifacts and stop before publication.

calls.purpose: Persist the complete reconciliation including discrepancies.

steps.instruction: Only with zero discrepancies, acquire the exclusive lease, re-read the prior head, create a legal reconcile model with exact claims and coverage fingerprints, archive it by content address and update only this feature head. Reuse an already-published identical model without duplicate writes.

writes.when: only when reconciliation has zero discrepancies
only when the immutable object is absent

calls.purpose: Re-read the current head under the publication lease.
Archive and republish the accepted reconciled model.
calls.when: only after every earlier criterion passes

steps.instruction: Write and validate the typed response. Mismatch retains reconciliation and claims without model; done requires the accepted model and no failed criteria. Do not claim more verification than bound evidence supports.

calls.purpose: Run scripts/validate_operator.py for this bundle and records.
Present the accepted reconciliation or complete discrepancies.
